name: SurrealDB
description: Workflows covering SurrealDB's HTTP REST API: record CRUD, raw SurrealQL queries, bulk import/export, and server health/version.

a1.name: GetHealth
a1.description: Checks the status of the database server and its underlying storage engine.

a2.name: GetVersion
a2.description: Returns the version of the SurrealDB database server.

a3.name: SelectAllRecords
a3.description: Selects all records in a table from the database.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

a4.name: CreateRecordInTable
a4.description: Creates a record in a table in the database, with a generated ID.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

a5.name: UpdateAllRecordsInTable
a5.description: Replaces every record in a table with the supplied content.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

body.description: Content to replace every record with.

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

a6.name: MergeAllRecordsInTable
a6.description: Merges the supplied content into every record in a table.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

body.description: Content to merge into every record.

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

a7.name: DeleteAllRecordsInTable
a7.description: Deletes every record in a table and returns each record's state before deletion.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

a8.name: SelectRecord
a8.description: Selects a specific record from the database.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

id.description: Record ID (the part after the table name in the record's identifier).

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

a9.name: CreateRecord
a9.description: Creates a record with a specific ID in the database.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

id.description: Record ID (the part after the table name in the record's identifier).

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

aa.name: UpdateRecord
aa.description: Replaces the content of a specific record.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

id.description: Record ID (the part after the table name in the record's identifier).

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

body.description: Content to replace the record with.

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

ab.name: MergeRecord
ab.description: Merges the supplied content into a specific record.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

id.description: Record ID (the part after the table name in the record's identifier).

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

body.description: Content to merge into the record.

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

ac.name: DeleteRecord
ac.description: Deletes a specific record and returns its state before deletion.

table.description: Name of the table to operate on.

id.description: Record ID (the part after the table name in the record's identifier).

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

id.description: Record identifier, in the form table:id.

ad.name: RunSurrealQLQuery
ad.description: Executes one or more raw SurrealQL statements and returns a result for each.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

query.description: One or more semicolon-separated SurrealQL statements.

ae.name: ExportData
ae.description: Exports data for a specific namespace and database. The optional body scopes what's included.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

body.description: Optional export options (users, accesses, params, functions, analyzers, tables, versions, records).

outputSchema.description: SurrealQL statements representing the exported data.

af.name: ImportData
af.description: Imports SurrealQL statements into a specific namespace and database.

namespace.description: Value sent as the Surreal-NS header (namespace).

database.description: Value sent as the Surreal-DB header (database).

statements.description: SurrealQL statements to import, as raw file content.
